implementation_constraints: Read entire stdin as single expression string

unresolved_intent.rationale: Spec requires -7/2=-3 not -4; Python's floor division (//) truncates toward negative infinity; using int(a/b) achieves required truncation toward zero
Unary operators are inherently right-associative; recursive parse_factor handles chains like -- 3 correctly as -(-(3))
Spec permits leading/trailing/newline whitespace and requires internal whitespace be insignificant; input.strip() before parsing and whitespace-skipping during tokenization satisfy both requirements
Recursive descent parser returns None on first parse error; evaluation shortcuts to ERROR output; this ensures single-pass parsing with deterministic error reporting
